entities.name: Query RibBA-like protein
observations: 389-aa sequence; predicted mass 43.37 kDa and theoretical pI 5.10.
Strong match to reviewed Staphylococcus epidermidis RibBA Q8CNU2 (59.1% identity, 99.7% query coverage; E=2.5e-156), supporting a bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme assignment by homology.

Reference RibBA catalyzes D-ribulose-5-phosphate conversion to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate and formate (EC 4.1.99.12), and GTP cyclohydrolase II activity in riboflavin biosynthesis (EC 3.5.4.25).
Homolog annotation indicates Mg2+ or Mn2+ and Zn2+ binding; treat cofactor assignment and activities as transferred from homologs, not experimentally verified for this sequence.

Homolog's annotated architecture comprises an N-terminal DHBP synthase region and a C-terminal GTP cyclohydrolase II region; query has similar full-length match, but boundaries are reference positions, not mapped query features.
